Method of Attack: Privilege escalation by failing to mimic JVM permissions allowing processes to run with elevated privileges
Container escape by tricking hot patch to execute malicious 'java' binary with elevated privileges
Hotdog not respecting device restrictions, syscall filters, and resource limits leading to malicious modifications, policy overrides, and resource exhaustion
Impacted Systems: Cloud or on-premise environments running Java applications with vulnerable Log4j
Containers regardless of running Java applications
Containers running with user namespaces or as non-root users
Attack Vector: Malicious container including a malicious 'java' binary to trick hot patch
Unprivileged process binary named 'java' tricking fixing service to execute with elevated privileges
